column1: light-amplification-lead-darmstadt-197837,Focused,Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d),"Darmstadt, DE",False,1793526013,"About Focused EnergyFocused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).
Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.
Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.
Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.
Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.
Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).
S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.
Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.
5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA
Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)

column1: senior-backend-developer-zurich-277178,"ServiceHunter AG - quitt, quinn",Senior Backend Developer,Zürich,False,1793393250,"Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.Why this role existsEvery market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.What you will ownBackend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.How we workWe are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.Your first yearIn your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.Who we are looking forYou have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.English is your working language. German is a plus.What makes you stand outYou have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.The teamWe are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.We are not filling a seat. If you would rather build the core than maintain the plumbing, we would like to hear from you.The factsLocation: Zürich Wiedikon, hybrid with three days a week in the office

column1: shift-supervisor-dsl-01-delfzijl-101992,Skynrg,Shift Supervisor | DSL-01,Delfzijl,False,1793428830,"Shift Supervisor | DSL-01Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.Jouw verantwoordelijkhedenTijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):Werk je in dagdienstDraag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructiesSpeel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operatorsOndersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatieZorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren. Jouw profielSkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richtingMinimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleidingMinimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrieAantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skillsErvaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemenKennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgevingErvaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomenWelkome extra kennis en ervaring:Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojectenErvaring met commissioning, startup en operational readinessKennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessenErvaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance managementOver DSL-01In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market.That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind.Role and ResponsibilitiesAs our Senior Product Designer, you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from.Craft and UI ownershipYou don't stop at concepts. column1: remote-senior-software-engineer-backend-data-streaming-132472,Camunda,"Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Data Streaming",Remote,True,1793461213,"Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.About the role:As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.What You Will Do:Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.What You Will Bring to the Role:Must Haves:7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.Nice to Haves:Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log systemExperience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.This role is an existing vacancy#LI-SK1 #LI-Remote #C1What We Have to Offer:CompensationWe offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. column1: senior-ai-engineer-location-ai-mapbox-germany-130867,Mapbox,"Senior AI Engineer, Location AI",Mapbox Germany,False,1793461213,"Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What you'll doThis role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.In this role, you will:Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.What We Believe are Important Traits for This RoleRequired Education/Certification: Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.Technical Skills &amp
column2: Tools (Must-Haves):2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.Core Competencies &amp
column3: Scope:Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.Nice to Have Traits for this RoleGeospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.Employment RequirementsEmployment Type: Full-timeWeekly Hours: 40 h per weekLocation/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)What We ValueIn addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support youHybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.Country-Specific Care &amp
column4: Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growthBalance &amp

Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application. column1: senior-product-engineer-devtools-ai-reliability-remote-berlin-277824,Checkly,"Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)",Remote (UTC-3 to UTC+3),False,1793428826,"(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. ""Is my app healthy?"" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!What you'll doBuild and ship with AIYou will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.Talk to our usersYou will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.Find the right problems to solveIn a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.Own your work end to endFrom shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.What you should haveYou have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.What you will hate about usWe would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.BenefitsTransparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.
We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.
But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.
At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.
The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

This is the role that owns the first impression. From the moment someone lands on our homepage to the point they hand over their payment details, you’ll shape every critical step. We’re redesigning how millions of pet lovers discover and join TrustedHousesitters - and this hire will lead that work. If you’ve spent your career moving conversion needles, experimenting relentlessly, and building beautiful product at speed, this is your next chapter.
The Role: Experimental, Visual, and Commercial

You’ll own the full acquisition and onboarding experience at TrustedHousesitters - web and mobile - sitting within the New Member Revenue squad. That means everything from the homepage and landing pages through to registration flows, onboarding nudges, and first payment. You’ll work directly with product, engineering, data, CRM, and our CRO Manager, and you’ll have real ownership of the experimentation roadmap for your area.

The challenge is genuinely interesting. Our product is loved - but our acquisition experience needs to match that. We’re running a push to make TrustedHousesitters feel as aspirational as Airbnb, peppering real trust signals and community moments into journeys that currently skew too utilitarian. You’ll need to balance a high visual bar with a rigorous test-and-learn mindset. Neither alone is enough.
Own the acquisition journey end-to-end: From homepage to first payment - web-first, with mobile increasingly in scope - including landing pages, onboarding flows, and lifecycle nudges.

Drive conversion through experimentation: Co-own the experimentation roadmap with our CRO Manager: frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and ship rapid tests. You should be able to name the number your last test moved.
Raise the visual bar: Strong UI craft is a non-negotiable - every surface you touch should feel considered, current, and well-executed.
Translate insight into shipped product: Self-serve with Amplitude, turn quantitative and qualitative signals into testable ideas, and move quickly from insight to design.
Shape strategy, not just output: Partner with product, engineering, data, and commercial teams - your voice should be in the room before decisions are made, not after.
The Growth Designer: You’ve owned acquisition or conversion work in-house, at pace - and you can tell the story of an experiment you ran, the hypothesis behind it, and the number it moved.
The Visual Craftsperson: Your portfolio stops people. You’ve worked where the visual bar is genuinely high and you hold yourself to that standard regardless of where you are.
The Hypothesis Writer: You think in problems before solutions - you can frame a clear problem statement, propose a test, and explain why that test design makes sense.
The Collaborator: You treat design as a shared effort, not a hand-off - you partner closely with PMs, engineers, data, and CRM and you’re a stronger designer for it.
The B2C Product Thinker: You’ve worked on consumer products - ideally marketplaces or subscriptions - and you understand how trust is built digitally and what actually makes someone convert.

Talent Screen: A 20-minute conversation with our Talent team to cover your background, motivations, and the role in detail.

Hiring Manager Interview: A 30-minute call with our Director of Design - a two-way conversation about your craft, your approach to growth design, and whether TrustedHousesitters is the right fit for you.

column3: Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.&amp
Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.&amp
Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities.&amp

Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count.&amp

Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one.&amp

Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model.&amp

Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale.&amp
Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up.&amp
Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve.&amp

Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions.&amp
Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch.&amp
Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation.&amp

Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships.&amp
Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands.&amp

Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar.&amp
Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences.&amp

Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer.&amp

Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work.&amp
Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services.&amp
Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences.&amp
Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone.&amp
Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room.&amp

column2: DRMillions of people build on Lovable, from software that runs new businesses to the tools that power existing ones. At the center of it all is trust. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now.Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too.The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. You’ll develop and own the spokesperson platforms for our CISO and other senior leaders who speak on our trust efforts, identifying and preparing them for on-stage and media opportunities. You’ll help them become recognized voices on topics of trust in AI software creation.Own incident communications, end to end. When something doesn’t go as planned, you’re the incident comms lead who ensures clear and swift communications for every audience that needs to hear from us, including media, customers, and employees. You’ll know the voices who matter most in telling our trust story, and you’ll make sure those relationships exist before we need them.Who you areYou’ve done trust, safety, or security communications. You have proven comms experience across a variety of trust-related topics, from AI safety to security. You’ve worked on or alongside security, privacy, or trust and safety teams.You have real incident experience. You’ve been the incident comms lead more than once, and you’ve probably written a playbook along the way. You bring the attention to detail, precision, speed, and judgment an incident requires.You have strong media relationships in the tech and AI ecosystem. Security and trust reporters, analysts, policy-adjacent media, perhaps even researchers. Your writing is precise, human, and accessible, even when the subject matter is complex or the situation is sensitive. You also catch things others may miss.You’re calm, hands-on, and low-ego. We care more about the right years than the number of them: judgment under pressure matters more than tenure.What you need to knowThis is a strategic but hands-on role with both proactive and reactive components. The trust story has to resonate outside of Silicon Valley and our home turf in Stockholm. Wherever you sit, you’ll work across time zones and build relationships with the teams whose work you’re talking about.Finally: joining Lovable Comms means you’re deeply curious, data-driven, and not extremely precious about role boundaries. column1: centrale-lyon-post-doctoral-position-ferroelectric-based-ternary-computing-from-circuit-design-to-system-level-integration-scientific-context-ecull-308099,CENTRALE LYON,CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context,"Ecully, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France",False,1793493076,"Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the ""memory wall"" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system.Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency.Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads.Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption.  Required Candidate ProfileThe ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field, and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills:Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus.Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset.System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus.Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing.Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation.Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English.Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. column1: lead-legal-counsel-regulatory-and-financial-services-paris-78505,Pennylane SAS,"Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services",All France (remote),False,1793439614,"Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?Then Pennylane is the right place for you !Our visionWe aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.About usPennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!) In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base. As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team.From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows.Organisation &amp
column2: ReportingYou will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.Mission &amp
column4: StructuringYou manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture.You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on.You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team.Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.Products, contracts and customer legal architectureYou own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).Outsourcing / BaaS transition &amp
column5: vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.Regulatory engagement support &amp
column6: internal enablementUntil we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&amp
column7: A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.Culture, Training &amp
column8: Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.About youYou have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment.You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).Skills &amp
column9: mindsetTechnical strengths You can credibly lead on :ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing
column10: Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments

column2: 2 jours avant départ) et d’améliorer la fluidité logistique. column1: lead-head-of-sales-europe-berlin-65230,Upvest,Lead/ Head of Sales Europe (f/m/d),Berlin,False,1793364013,"At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. plans that set out each client's growth path with Upvest, from new use cases and asset classes to new functionality and geographiesAdvise clients on their end-user investment offering (product, counterpart for client leadership teams, from handover after go-live through renewals and escalationsLead QBRs, Steering Committees and executive alignment, keeping stakeholders aligned from C-level to technical teamsAct as the filter between our clients and the wider Upvest organisation: answer most product, asset class and commercial questions directly, run client meetings independently with your team, and bring in others only where they add real valueBe the first point of escalation for live clients, resolving issues quickly and coordinating the wider organisation where neededRepresent the voice of the client inside Upvest, channelling structured feedback to Product, Operations and GrowthSafeguard the partnership by ensuring contract adherence on both sidesPerformance and insightOwn the portfolio KPIs: ARR, net and gross revenue retention, and client satisfaction (CSAT and Account Health Score)Track client performance (users, conversions, assets under custody, trading activity) against plan, and use anonymised benchmarks to help clients improveOwn the client input to the annual budget and the monthly actuals vs budget review with FinanceReport to senior management on account health, risks and opportunities, with clear actionable recommendationsTeam and operating modelLead, hire and develop a team of senior Account Managers, setting a high bar for quality, execution speed and commercial impactDefine and continuously improve how Upvest manages its live clients: account tiering, governance cadences, account health scoring, documentation and toolingDrive AI adoption across Account Management, using Claude and system integrations to automate analysis, reporting and preparation workWork very closely with Client Experience who own the day to day operational alignment and ticket resolutionWhat you bring:Experience: 8+ years in account management, client success or strategic relationship management for B2B enterprise clients, of which 3+ years leading an account management or client teamInvestment and brokerage expertise: You can discuss asset types in depth (equities, ETFs, funds and MMFs, bonds, securitised derivatives, crypto) and the trading, custody, settlement and fee economics behind them. column1: 3d-computer-vision-research-engineer-geospatial-visual-localization-london-21403,Niantic Spatial,"3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization",London,False,1793428828,"About Niantic SpatialAI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.About the RoleWe are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.What You'll DoDesign, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.What You'll BringStrong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.Nice to HaveA PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. column1: infrastructure-software-engineering-platform-build-london-jj-mack-265667,Fractile,Infrastructure Software Engineering – Platform & Build,London - JJ Mack,False,1793428827,"About FractileFractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech.

Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein.
Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud.
Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.
L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles :
- le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures
- le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients

En tant que Lead SRE/DevOps, tu encadres techniquement une équipe de SRE/DevOps et travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients. Tu es toi-même managé par un ou une Engineering Manager, qui t’accompagne dans ta montée en compétences de lead.
Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner.
En tant que Lead SRE/DevOps, tu es responsable de la réussite de ton projet, sur les plans technique, organisationnel et humain. Tu es garant de la qualité technique des projets confiés à ton équipe.
Porter la stratégie technique et l’architecture :
- Définir une vision claire et durable de l’infrastructure et des pratiques SRE
- Concevoir des architectures robustes, sécurisées et scalables, et savoir les expliquer
- Construire une stratégie technique adaptée au contexte (infra from scratch, migration, automatisation, DevX, sécurité, bonnes pratiques DevOps…)
- Challenger les choix techniques du projet pour optimiser les coûts (design-to-cost, cost reduction)
Assurer le delivery et la qualité des livrables :
- Rester hands-on : contribuer activement et garantir la solidité du delivery
- Assurer la qualité, la performance et la cohérence technique des livrables
- Produire et faire évoluer l’infrastructure : Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS / Google Cloud, etc.
- Proposer des alternatives pragmatiques quand un choix met en danger l’exécution (complexité, coûts, dette technique)
Faire progresser les membres plus juniors de ton équipe :
- Aider les SRE/DevOps les plus juniors à monter en compétences, via de la formation en situation de travail sur les compétences clés (matrice de compétences)
- Pratiquer le pair programming, la revue de code et l’accompagnement technique
- Analyser les défauts et incidents pour renforcer les connaissances de l’équipe et améliorer le système
En tant que Lead, tu peux évoluer vers deux tracks possibles :
- une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager
- une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

- Tu as l’envie de travailler en équipe et de contribuer au développement de l’entreprise

- Tu sais trancher des choix techniques et expliquer tes arbitrages (risques, coûts, scalabilité, maintenabilité)

Notre process dure 1 semaine en moyenne.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.&lt

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.&lt

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.&lt

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.&lt

column1: We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

- le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients
Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients.

Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients.
Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner.
En tant que DevOps Engineer, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe.
Au run les missions consistent à :
- Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies
- Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients
- Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure
- Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais)

- mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD
- mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting
- apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients
- participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet
La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat.

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech.

Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein.
Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud.
Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.
L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles :
- le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures
- le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients
Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients.

Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients.
Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner.
En tant que Cloud Engineer, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe.
Au run les missions consistent à :
- Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies
- Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients
- Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure
- Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais)
Au build tu apprendras à comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client sur sa stratégie d’infrastructure :
- mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD
- mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting
- apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients
- participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet
La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat.

Ce poste de Cloud Engineer est fait pour les personnes curieuses qui veulent monter en compétences rapidement, au contact d’un large panel d’infrastructures et d’outils (AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, Outscale, OVH, …) et de bugs complexes en production.

Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à cœur : la formation des équipes business, la diversité, ou le recrutement technique…

La première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead, et de devenir ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles :
- une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager
- une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :
Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

- Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’une bonne gestion du stress, et sais intervenir efficacement sur des environnements de production
- Tu as l’envie de progresser rapidement et de travailler en équipe

- Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique.
Nous répondons à toutes les candidatures dans un délai de 2 jours.
Si ton parcours retient notre attention, voici le process qu’on te propose :
- un appel téléphonique de 30 minutes avec un membre de l’équipe recrutement, pour comprendre tes critères de recherche
- un entretien d’une heure avec le recruteur ou la recruteuse avec qui tu as échangé à la première étape, pour parler plus en détail de la culture Theodo
