column1: This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.
You will operate across two horizons:
Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.
The ultimate objective is not simply to make Swile harder to breach. It is to make a breach increasingly uninteresting, because there is less usable data available to steal.What you will do
We want Security Engineering to create capabilities that scale across hundreds of engineers.
Identify and reduce high-impact security risks across our applications, APIs and internal tools.
Strengthen authentication, authorization and access controls.
Improve the protection of sensitive and personal data.
Design controls that limit the blast radius of compromised accounts, services or infrastructure.
Improve security monitoring, auditability and detection of suspicious access patterns.
Perform threat modelling and targeted security reviews.
Build reusable security capabilities directly into our engineering platform and development lifecycle.
Contribute to long-term architectures around data isolation, encryption, tokenisation and privacy-preserving systems.
Partner with engineering teams to address systemic security risks rather than individual findings.
Where possible, a security requirement should become code rather than documentation.
What we are looking forYou are first and foremost a strong engineer.

You have significant experience building or securing production software and distributed systems. You are comfortable reading and writing production code, designing systems and working directly with Engineering teams.
You have deep security engineering expertise and strong experience in several of the following areas:
Cryptography, KMS / HSM and envelope encryption
Threat modelling and secure software architecture

Il couvre le cardiovasculaire (ApoB, Lp(a)…), le métabolisme (insuline, HOMA-IR, HbA1c), le foie, le rein, la thyroïde, l’inflammation (hs-CRP), les micronutriments et les hormones.💬 Un questionnaire d’environ 200 questions sur le mode de vie, les objectifs et les antécédents.🎯 Un rapport personnalisé généré par IA et validé par nos médecins, qui contient l’analyse de chaque biomarqueur en contexte, un Score de Santé, un Âge Biologique, des recommandations sur le mode de vie et un plan d’action avec 3-5 objectifs prioritaires basés sur les grands “piliers” de la prévention (activité physique, nutrition, santé mentale, sommeil, …).🔍 Ce que nous recherchonsNous recrutons des médecins généralistes curieux de prévention et de médecine de précision, pour rejoindre le petit groupe de médecins qui relisent et valident les rapports Alan Précision.✅ Curieux(se) de ce que l’IA peut apporter à la pratique✅ Convaincu(e) que prévention et accompagnement changent vraiment la vie des patients✅ Un vrai intérêt pour la thématique et l'envie d'apprendre : un DU (nutrition, prévention…) est un plus, mais pas indispensable✅ Disponible au moins 4h par semaine (horaires flexibles)✅ Statut libéral🧠 Votre rôle : le regard médical qui fait la différenceL’IA prépare, vous validez. Avant d’arriver chez le membre, chaque rapport passe entre vos mains : vous en êtes le garant médical, et c’est votre expertise qui en fait un rapport fiable et utile.Concrètement, vous :Relisez le rapport généré par l’IA et vérifier son exactitude médicaleVous vous assurez que les interprétations collent au profil de la personne (âge, sexe, activité, habitudes)Apportez la nuance que seul un médecin sait apporter :un lien de causalité trop affirmatif (« est causé par » doit devenir « peut être lié à »)une formulation anxiogèneune incohérence entre les sections du rapportune recommandation qui ne correspond pas au profilune supplémentation exotique ou mal étayéeÊtes le filet de sécurité : vous bloquez et faites remonter les situations qui sortent du cadre de la prévention (valeur critique, pathologie active suspectée, interaction médicamenteuse…)Signalez les erreurs récurrentes de l’IA : vos corrections servent directement à améliorer les rapports suivantsA noter:Vous n’écrivez pas les rapports, vous ne prescrivez pas, et vous n’échangez pas directement avec les utilisateurs. Les résultats biologiques arrivent automatiquement par MSSanté.Tout se fait en asynchrone : pas de créneau fixe, pas de patient qui attend. Vous relisez les rapports quand vous voulez — le soir, entre deux consultations, le week-end.Il s'agit donc d'une activité complémentaire idéale pour diversifier votre exercice, sans salle d’attente ni urgence. 🙌 Pourquoi rejoindre Alan ?🔬 Une thématique passionnante. Médecine de précision, biomarqueurs, prévention avancée qui associe biologie et mode de vie : une approche encore rare en France, que vous pratiquerez au quotidien. Enfin le temps de faire de la prévention approfondie, celle qu'une consultation de 15 minutes ne permet pas.🎓 Une expertise qui enrichit votre pratique. Vous développez des compétences rares (ApoB, Lp(a), insulinorésistance, micronutrition…) que vous pourrez aussi mobiliser auprès de vos propres patients.📚 Formation et partage. Onboarding et formation à la médecine de précision, sessions d'échange entre médecins, veille scientifique.🏥 Un cadre médical structuré. Vous exercez dans un cadre clair, conforme aux exigences réglementaires et déontologiques, pour des prises en charge cohérentes, harmonisées et sécurisées. Des médecins référents vous accompagnent dans les situations cliniques difficiles.🤝 Un petit groupe de pionniers. Au-delà de la mission freelance, vous rejoignez la communauté d'une dizaine de médecins qui construisent Alan Précision : partage de connaissances, échanges sur les cas, et vos retours qui orientent directement l'évolution du produit. Vous faites aussi partie de la Clinic Alan et de ses plus de 120 professionnels de santé.🤖 Co-construire l'avenir de la médecine. Quelle place pour l'IA dans le parcours de soin? Chez Alan, les médecins sont au cœur de ces réflexions et impliqués dans son développement.💰 Des conditions attractives. Nous proposons une rémunération attractive (70€/h), une grande flexibilité d’organisation (travail 100 % asynchrone et à distance) et l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une communauté médicale engagée.Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow",['git'],1

column1: head-of-changeorg-germany-snr-communications-manager-berlin-125961,Change.org,"Head of Change.org, Germany - (snr Communications Manager)",Berlin,False,1793256018,"Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Communications Manager to lead our team in Germany, as Head of Change.org, Germany. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. The job also involves being the public voice of Change.org in the German media. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through an exceptional network, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle.We'd welcome ambitious Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role.Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions.What you will achieveCreate awareness spikes. Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events.Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win.Earn trust across the political spectrum. Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks into how the team works.Mobilise your network. Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers.Be our voice. Act as Change.org's external spokesperson in Germany on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations.Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team.Lead with AI. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter.What you bringA track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks.Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts.A strong network. You have trusted relationships with German journalists, editors and producers (ideally including key decision makers), and connections in politics and civil society across the whole democratic political spectrum, including conservative circles. You can use your contacts to place stories.Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You set priorities, give direct feedback and bring out the best in people. At a Senior Manager level, you would move resources as the news and priorities shift.Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are an experienced, media-trained spokesperson on live TV and radio and in front of senior stakeholders, and you handle tough interviews, crisis moments and politically sensitive questions with ease.AI First: You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along.Target experience5-8+ years in communications, campaigning, political communications, a newsroom or an agency.3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team.A proven track record of national campaigns in Germany that created significant public attention and media coverage.Experience as an organisation's spokesperson in national broadcast and / or  print media.Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work.Native-level German (C2) and professional English.Interested? Great! Here's what you should knowThis role is based in Berlin. It is a full-time hybrid role, and we expect you to be in the Berlin office 2-3 days per week, with flexibility to work remotely for the rest of the week.Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is €95,500 in Berlin. We are also open to candidates at the Manager level and the annual salary in Berlin is €83,500.We recognise that people assess their qualifications differently, and you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe you could be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. Change.org is an open platform designed to serve people across the full range of viewpoints. Effectively supporting that mission requires teams with a wide variety of experiences, skills and perspectives, which we consider essential to our work.We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, or any other status protected by law.We're committed to protecting your data. To learn more, please review our Change.org Job Applicant Privacy Policy.We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities throughout our recruitment process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know.Professional-level English proficiency is required for all roles. While we are a global company, we ask that all CVs and application responses be submitted in English. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow",['excel'],1

column1: founding-growth-alan-precision-paris-france-39638,Alan,Founding Growth - Alan Precision,"Paris, France",False,1793266826,"Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.Alan exists to end the wait.Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.⭐ Alan Precision: why this existsYour body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.We don't accept that.Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.⭐ The Founding Growth opportunityAlan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market. Once the internal engine runs:Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by AlanYour levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.Across all three:Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages.Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned.Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job.⭐ Is it you we're looking for?Fluent in French and English.You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why.A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next.Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io, Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments.Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue.Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise.Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director.Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships.Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician.Nice to havesExperience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services).B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech.Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C.Pricing and packaging of subscription offers.You own your own health: Whoop, Oura, blood tests, supplements are no secret for you.🌍 How we workLocation: ParisRemote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.You want to know more about Alan?🙌 Perks &amp

column1: senior-economist-fur-energiemarkte-bei-dezernat-zukunft-institut-fur-makrofinanzen-berlin-191229,Dezernat Zukunft,(Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte (w/m/d) bei Dezernat Zukunft – Institut für Makrofinanzen,Berlin,False,1793244815,"Wer wir sind und was wir suchenOb die Energiewende gelingt, entscheidet sich nicht allein an Technologien, sondern an Kosten, Märkten und politischen Weichenstellungen. Genau dazu arbeitet das Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft – und um unsere Arbeit weiter zu vertiefen, suchen wir Dich. Das Dezernat Zukunft ist ein überparteilicher Berliner Think Tank an der Schnittstelle von Politik, Verwaltung und Forschung. Rund 30 Personen verfolgen gemeinsam das Ziel, Geld-, Finanz- und Wirtschaftspolitik neu zu denken und verständlich zu vermitteln. Geleitet von den Werten Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte. In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht.Deine AufgabenDu analysierst Energiemärkte und -preise, einschließlich Systemkosten, und koordinierst dazu Forschungsprojekte. Dabei betrachtest Du auch fiskalpolitische Auswirkungen sowie Wechselwirkungen mit dem Stromnetzausbau. Du entwickelst konkrete Politikvorschläge, Analysen und Positionen zu den oben genannten Themen, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Deinen Kolleg:innen im Energy Lab des Dezernat Zukunft sowie den weiteren Teams der Organisation. Außerdem organisierst Du Expert:innen-Gespräche und andere inhaltliche Veranstaltungen. Du interagierst aktiv mit Vertreter:innen von Parlamenten, Regierungen, Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Medien. If not, we'll get you there by week 2.Have managed a book of advertiser or partner accounts in performance marketing, mobile gaming UA, or rewarded UA. If not, we're more than willing to develop you into that role.Have used tools like AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Singular, or want to learn.Have built and grown a book of business in a measurable way.Top-tier consulting (MBB) or scale-up background. We hire the for right thoughts. Rewarded-UA depth comes in your first 60 days.Have actually used Hex, worked inside the admin of a rewarded UA platform, or been on the advertiser side of one.What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟Own Everything: Get It Done. You don't ask for permission to fix obvious things.Take Initiative: Be Proactive. You spot the geo where the cap consistently under-fills. You ask the algo team why. You propose the test. column1: At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.

Build the analysis behind every recommendation — sizing, segmentation, business cases, operational data — so decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition alone.

Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.&lt

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.&lt

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.&lt

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.&lt

In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.&lt

column1: senior-hub-developer-edinburgh-247899,Ember,Senior Hub Developer,"Edinburgh, Scotland, United Kingdom",False,1793277104,"We're looking for a developer to grow Ember's network of charging hubs. You'll find the sites, take them through legals and planning, manage the build and energise them. How you work and think matters more to us than which industry you've worked in. You think clearly, can run several projects at once and are as at home on a site as behind a desk.About EmberWe're building the future of public transport — convenient, affordable, connected and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier and more enjoyable to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car.Ember is a tech company, not a traditional bus operator. We've built a platform that coordinates our entire operation — everything from monitoring vehicles and controlling chargers to selling tickets and calculating ETAs. This allows us to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world, leading to a massive reduction in emissions. It also helps us provide a much better passenger experience, with innovative features like demand-responsive stops.We’re still tiny, with a handful of routes and ~100 buses. The challenge is to scale this 50x whilst staying lean, increasing efficiency and delivering an even better product experience. We’ve recently raised a Series A from some of Europe’s leading climate VCs and are looking for mission-driven individuals who want to get on board and help take us to the next level.The roleCharging hubs are Ember's key growth enabler. They give us the ultra-fast charge points we need to run our network, and they act as a base for our fleet — parking, washing, driver lounges and more. We have hubs across Scotland today, with additional sites across the UK under construction or in the pipeline.You'll join a small team of four, taking end-to-end responsibility for your own sites and helping out on others. We're typically running a handful of projects at any one time.Step one is finding a site. You’ll need to think about where we need charging capacity to support future routes, scout industrial estates and brownfield plots and reach out to commercial agents, local authorities and landlords. Some great sites are advertised but many are not, so landing one usually means being patient and creative.Once you've got a site, we move on to lease negotiations, design, the planning application and the power connection. You'll work with network operators to land the grid connection, and with our suppliers to procure, install and commission the charging equipment. Solicitors, architects and engineers are there to help, but the project is yours to drive — you set the direction, you ask the difficult questions and you make the trade-offs.It’s important to be hands-on. We don't go to tender and leave the rest to an outsourced project manager — we want you on site, asking why a kerb is in the wrong place. Even after a site is live, our involvement doesn't stop. The team keeps refining and improving every site, and you'll be part of that work across the network, not just on the sites you've built yourself.Diversity and equalityAt Ember, we support diversity across our team and customers. We work to ensure every employee feels respected and able to give their best, whether temporary, part-time or full-time. We’re happy to offer flexible working patterns where they make sense, are compassionate when it comes to time off and offer enhanced maternity and paternity leave.Read more about our approach in our Equal Opportunities Policy.What's on offerYou'll receive a salary of £50,000–£75,000 per annum, depending on your experience and skills, plus share options. You'll be expected to work from our lovely office in central Edinburgh most days — we value in-person communication — but there's flexibility around the odd day from home, with an expectation that you'll spend some time travelling to different sites.How do I apply?Send your CV and a short note on why this interests you.Applications close Friday 27 November at 5pm.  Who we're looking forYou should have a desire to get involved in the growth of a quickly scaling business, with a real opportunity to make your mark. How you work and think matters more to us than specific industry experience. The following should sound a lot like you:Curious and quick to learn. You're comfortable in unfamiliar territory — new technical specs, new legal terms, new planning processes — and you treat each one as an opportunity to learn. You don't expect to know everything on day one.Engineering mindset. You're the sort of person who'll happily watch YouTube videos explaining concrete reinforcement, three-phase distribution or substation transformers. You'll be excited to dive into the same level of detail on our projects.A first-principles thinker. You take problems back to fundamentals rather than reaching for jargon or the way things are usually done. When you work with experts — solicitors, architects, engineers — you treat them as people you can learn from, not people you can outsource your thinking to.Commercially astute. You can tell when something is worth fighting for and when it's better to redesign around a constraint, whether that's a lease, a planning condition or a contractor's quote.Highly organised. Managing a pipeline of projects is complex, with many timelines, people to chase, details to look into and things that can (and will) go wrong. We want you at Inbox Zero, not in inbox hell.Comfortable using AI. At a minimum you use it as part of how you work — to learn faster, draft documents and get to the bottom of unfamiliar topics. But maybe you’ll go further and build software to help the team work faster and more precisely.Hands-on. Hubs are built in the real world, not behind a screen. You'll meet landlords, talk to electricians and look at drains, but you'll also need to read contracts and chase agents who've gone quiet.A strong sense of what good looks like. Whatever the topic, problem or issue. You need to know how to hold yourself and others to a high standard.Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow",[],0

column1: scriptwriter-paris-178676,Finary,Scriptwriter,Paris,False,1793115632,"La mission de FinaryNotre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Le bon conseil financier a toujours existé, mais il était réservé à ceux qui dépassaient un certain seuil de patrimoine. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun.Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité. Pourquoi maintenant ?Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre. Ce que nous offronsNous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour.Découvrez nos valeurs ici.---LE POSTEFinary construit la banque privée de la génération internet. Notre chaîne YouTube est la première chaîne de finances personnelles en France : 880 000 abonné·es et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, entièrement produite en interne par une équipe qui traite le contenu comme un produit, c’est-à-dire mesuré, itéré, conçu avec méthode.Tu prends en charge tout ce qui s’écrit chez Finary Media, de bout en bout : recherche, script, packaging, vérification des faits, livraison. Les mots t’appartiennent, de la première idée au montage final.Tes deux terrains de jeu principaux :La chaîne YouTube Finary. Des vidéos longues qui mêlent storytelling, économie et investissement, regardées par des centaines de milliers de personnes. Ton point de repère : nos meilleures vidéos dépassent le million de vues.Finary One. Le contenu de notre offre de gestion de patrimoine, destiné à des investisseur·ses averti·es disposant de plus d’un million d’euros de patrimoine. C’est l’écriture aux enjeux les plus élevés chez Finary : moins de vues, mais des conséquences bien plus importantes.Tu écris aussi pour tous les formats qui gravitent autour : la préparation du podcast Finary Talk, et tout ce qui a besoin de mots. Si c’est écrit et que ça compte, c’est pour toi.Deux éléments distinguent ce poste de tout autre métier de scénariste :Tu passes devant la caméra. Tu présentes toi-même tes scripts. Ce n’est pas une option, cela fait partie du métier ici.Tu travailles nativement avec l’IA. Notre système de production repose sur des workflows LLM, des skills sur mesure et de l’automatisation. Tu ne te contenteras pas d’utiliser ces outils, tu construiras les tiens. La personne idéale pour ce poste a déjà construit des choses : prompts, agents, bases de connaissances, petits scripts.À QUOI RESSEMBLE LA RÉUSSITEUne de tes vidéos dépasse le million de vues dans tes trois premiers moisÀ partir du troisième mois, ton contenu Finary One génère 100 M€ d’encours prospects chaque mois90 % de tes scripts sont validés en un seul tour de relecture, et tes délais de production baissentTU ES FAIT·E POUR CE POSTE SI TU ASUne maîtrise experte de l’investissement et des finances personnelles : tu peux aller en profondeur, sans notes, sur le private equity, l’immobilier, les enveloppes fiscales et la structuration patrimonialeUne expérience d’écriture éprouvée face à un vrai public (YouTube, presse, newsletter, blog), avec des résultats à montrerUne rigueur factuelle sans faille : aucune erreur de données, de chiffres ou de concepts, jamaisLa concision comme réflexe, à l’écrit comme à l’oralUne autonomie totale : tu gères ton propre système, tu tiens tes délais, et personne n’a besoin de te relancerUne pratique native de l’IA : tu construis avec les LLM et l’automatisation parce que c’est ta façon de penserDe l’aisance face caméra, ou l’envie d’y arriver viteLES PLUSTu as écrit pour des chaînes YouTube performantes, ou tu as la tienneUn parcours en finance, en gestion d’actifs ou dans la fintechTu as mené seul·e un petit projet de code, une skill Claude ou un pipeline d’automatisationEntretiensLes entretiens avec les candidat·es francophones se déroulent en français. column2: :École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.Le poste est ouvert au sein le centre RAPSODEE (Recherche d'Albi en génie des Procédés des Solides Divisés, de l'Énergie et de l'Environnement) UMR CNRS 5302 d’IMT Mines Albi, dans le cadre du projet de collaboration avec GRDF sur l’intégration de nouveaux gaz renouvelables dans le réseau de gaz naturel.Les activités du centre RAPSODEE sont structurées en deux groupes de recherche dans les domaines de l’énergie, de l’environnement et du génie particulaire avec un accent particulier sur des procédés durables&nbsp
column3: : plus intenses, plus économes en énergie, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus sûrs. La plateforme VALTHERA est rattachée au centre RAPSODEE. Les travaux réalisés sur la plateforme le sont essentiellement à l’échelle pilote et sont centrés sur les procédés thermochimiques pour la production d’énergies renouvelables.GRDF est le gestionnaire du plus grand réseau de distribution de gaz en Europe. GRDF s’inscrit dans une trajectoire de décarbonation, avec une volonté de multiplier par cinq la production de gaz renouvelable pour attendre 20% de gaz renouvelable dans le réseau GRDF à l’échéance 2030, mais également d’aider les consommateurs de gaz à réduire leur empreinte carbone. Dans ce cadre, GRDF souhait renforcer la connaissance et maîtrise des procédés d'épuration du syngaz, étape clé pour garantir sa compatibilité avec les procédés de méthanation et, à terme, la production de méthane conforme aux exigences d’injection dans le réseau de gaz.DESCRIPTION DU POSTE&nbsp
column4: :En qualité d’ingénieur de recherche, vous intégrerez une équipe comprenant des ingénieurs, techniciens et enseignants chercheurs travaillant dans la recherche sur les procédés thermiques de valorisation de biomasse et déchets.Le projet que vous devrez développer cherche à analyser les différentes technologies d’épuration à intégrer dans une chaîne d’épuration globale de gaz de synthèse. La chaîne d’épuration a un impact conséquent sur les coûts d’investissement et d’opérations du procédé de production de biogaz par gazéification de biomasse ou déchets. Il est essentiel de simplifier le schéma d’épuration et d’essayer de minimiser la génération d’effluents afin de réduire les coûts des opérations unitaires. Le choix des briques technologiques dépend de la qualité du gaz de synthèse produit qui dépend du gisement utilisé, de la technologie du gazéifieur et des conditions opératoires.Le projet n’inclut pas de travail expérimental. Il sera basé exclusivement sur l’analyse bibliographique et la modélisation 0D de la chaîne d’épuration. La modélisation sera réalisée via des logiciels commerciaux et plus idéalement grâce à des logiciels Open source.Les principales tâches que le candidat retenu devra prendre en charge sont&nbsp
column11: La réalisation d’un état de l’art des différentes briques technologies de traitement et d’épuration de biogaz, ainsi que des différentes chaînes existantes dans la littérature.·&nbsp
column17: Une meilleure appréhension de l’impact de la composition des gisements sur la qualité du gaz en sortie du gazéifieur et l’impact de celui-ci sur la chaine d’épuration.·&nbsp
column23: L’identification des verrous techniques, des incertitudes et des lacunes de connaissances limitant la maîtrise des différentes briques technologiques.·&nbsp
column29: Une proposition de modèles des chaines d’épuration (simulation 0D) afin d’établir les bilans de matières et d’énergie et d’estimer la performance globale du procédé.·&nbsp

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.The Role

Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like “Why are we delaying so many flights?” or “How can we better identify instances of money laundering?” As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions. As an FDSE, your responsibilities look similar to those of a startup CTO: you’ll work in small teams with minimal supervision and own end-to-end execution of high stakes projects. Your day might span discussing architecture with fellow engineers, wrangling massive-scale data, coding a custom web app, speaking with customer executives, or establishing strategy for your team. Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place — with the best colleagues — to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. You’ll work autonomously and make decisions independently, within a community that will support and challenge you as you grow and develop.Core Responsibilities
Impact: We take on meaningful and challenging projects that change the world for the better.
Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end, working through any obstacles we may encounter.

Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other FDSEs, product teams, and Deployment Strategists. We also work externally with our customers, often on site, to understand and solve their problems.
Trust: We trust each other to effectively manage time and priorities and give people the space to think for themselves.
Growth: We encourage ourselves and our peers to seek new challenges and opportunities for growth, as well as find new ways to innovate and share knowledge.
Learning: We often face entirely novel problems where we need to pick up a lot of new knowledge and learn how to use it to make progress. We believe experiential learning is one of the best teachers.
Strong engineering background, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science.
A highly analytical mindset and eagerness to solve technical problems with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.

column3: Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.&lt

column3: NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re deploying large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters, including GB200 and GB300 rack-scale systems, into live data centres on tight customer commit dates. On those schedules, a design error found on site costs weeks and real money. We need one architect per deployment who takes the high-level design and turns it into something that can actually be built, then stays with it until the customer signs off.&lt

Take each cluster from CTO handover to customer acceptance as its single design authority, so nothing is ordered or installed against a design you haven’t validated&lt
Turn high-level designs and initial BOMs into build-ready low-level designs, hall layouts, rack elevations, P2P maps and cable schedules that site teams can build from without having to call you&lt
Design the InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric, power, direct liquid cooling and containment to fit the real constraints of each data centre&lt
Validate every BOM before it goes to procurement, and make part substitution calls knowing exactly what breaks when a line changes&lt
Hold OEMs and integrators (NVIDIA, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others) to their technical commitments, from FAT witness through to on-site issue resolution&lt
Build the reference designs and building blocks that mean each new deployment starts from a known-good baseline rather than a blank page&lt

You’ve designed and delivered large-scale GPU or HPC clusters into live data centres, and you were on site for the build&lt
Deep, practical knowledge of NVIDIA platforms (GB200/GB300 rack-scale and HGX H200/B200) and what each one demands of a facility&lt
Cluster-scale InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric design: topology, rail optimisation, oversubscription, and cable and optic selection&lt
Physical infrastructure design across power and redundancy, direct liquid cooling and CDUs, containment and achievable cable lengths&lt
You know part numbers, what’s optional and what isn’t, and you can hold an OEM to account when their commitments slip&lt
Factory integration and FAT experience, including holding a dispatch gate&lt
Storage design for AI workloads (WEKA, VAST, DDN, Ceph or similar)&lt
Deployments across multiple geographies and data centre operators, including sites requiring fit-out&lt
Neocloud or hyperscale experience on compressed schedules&lt
Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme&lt
Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)&lt
Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment&lt
Visible, meaningful impact as we scale&lt
Clear career progression in a high-growth company&lt
A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership&lt
The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future&lt

ui-ux-engineer-berlin-276613,Bsteuern,UI/UX Engineer,Berlin,False,1793104814,"Betriebliche Steuern sind kompliziert – Steuerberatung muss es nicht sein. Für die meisten Unternehmen bedeutet sie bis heute Papierstapel, lange E-Mail-Verläufe und Warten. Das wollen wir grundlegend ändern.Bei b'steuern verbinden wir Steuerberatung, Software und KI von Anfang an miteinander. Unser Ziel ist nicht, eine klassische Steuerkanzlei einfach digitaler zu machen. Wir definieren neu, was Steuerberatung bdeutet: mit KI-Agenten, die ganze Arbeitsabläufe eigenständig übernehmen, und Software, die Menschen genau dort einbindet, wo sie gebraucht werden.Daraus entstehen Designfragen, für die es noch kaum etablierte Antworten gibt: Wie übergibt man Arbeit an einen KI-Agenten? Wie behält man den Überblick, wenn mehrere Agenten gleichzeitig arbeiten? Wann kann man ihren Ergebnissen vertrauen? Und wie gestaltet man die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Menschen und KI so, dass sie sich einfach und selbstverständlich anfühlt?Als UI/UX Engineer findest du Antworten auf diese Fragen – und setzt sie selbst in funktionierende Software um. Du gestaltest die Produkte, mit denen unsere Mandant:innen und unser Steuerteam täglich arbeiten. column1: online-marketing-trainee-frankfurt-am-main-353476,Klickkonzept by Cosmo5,Online Marketing Trainee (m/w/d),Frankfurt am Main,False,1793098855,"Hallo!

Wir sind Klickkonzept. Eine datengetriebene, KI-orientierte Online-Marketing-Agentur im Herzen von Frankfurt. Als Teil der internationalen Cosmo5-Gruppe betreuen wir großartige Marken aus E-Commerce, Luxus, Beauty und B2B. Was uns besonders macht? Echte Leidenschaft, eine offene Kultur und die Überzeugung, dass jeder Einzelne bei uns Großes bewirken kann.

Du stehst am Anfang deiner Karriere im digitalen Marketing und hast keine Lust auf Kaffee kochen oder monotone Dateneingabe? Du willst tief in die Mechanik von Google, Amazon, Meta & Co. eintauchen und verstehen, wie Unternehmen heute online wirklich Geld verdienen – von der Suchanzeige über den Social Feed bis zum KI-Chatbot, der Kaufentscheidungen prägt? Dann bist du hier genau richtig.
Unser Versprechen: Vom Anfänger zum Strategie-Designer

Wir suchen keine fertigen Experten. Wir suchen smarte, analytische Köpfe mit dem unbedingten Willen zu lernen. In unserem Trainee-Programm bilden wir dich zum sogenannten „T-Shaped Marketer"" aus. Was das heißt? Gemeinsam wählen wir deinen vertikalen Schwerpunkt – deine Spezialdisziplin, in der du echte Tiefe aufbaust:
Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.
Paid Social - Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co.
Amazon Ads / Retail Media - Werbung dort, wo gekauft wird
SEO & GEO - organische Sichtbarkeit in klassischen Suchmaschinen und in KI-Antwortsystemen wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Google AI Overviews

Das ist der vertikale Strich im „T"". Gleichzeitig bringen wir dir bei, wie das gesamte digitale Marketing-Ökosystem zusammenspielt (der horizontale Strich) – denn die spannendsten Ergebnisse entstehen genau dort, wo die Kanäle ineinandergreifen. Du lernst nicht nur, wie man Knöpfe in Werbekonten oder Tools drückt. Wir machen dich zum strategischen Berater, der versteht, wie messbarer Impact und echter Umsatz für Unternehmen generiert werden.

Das Handwerk lernen: Du lernst von der Pike auf, wie Kampagnen und Maßnahmen in deiner Spezialdisziplin aufgebaut, umgesetzt und optimiert werden - ob Paid-Kampagnen, Amazon-Werbung oder SEO/GEO-Maßnahmen.

Operative Exzellenz: Recherche und Analyse, das Verfassen psychologisch cleverer Texte und Creatives, Zielgruppen- und Keyword-Definitionen sowie das Erstellen aussagekräftiger Performance-Reports werden zu deiner täglichen Routine.

Analytisches Arbeiten: Du unterstützt unsere erfahrenen Account Manager bei Marktforschungen und Analysen. Du lernst, wie man Rohdaten interpretiert und in strategische Empfehlungen für den Kunden übersetzt.
Verantwortung übernehmen: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung wirst du Tag für Tag und Woche für Woche mehr lernen und eigene Schwerpunkte in deinen Kundenprojekten setzen.

KI verstehen: Du bekommst Einblicke in unser „AI Lab"" und lernst, wie moderne Marketer Künstliche Intelligenz nutzen, um ihre tägliche Arbeit effizienter zu gestalten - und wie sich Sichtbarkeit im Zeitalter von generativer Suche neu definiert.
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medienwissenschaften o.ä.) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung - aber viel wichtiger ist uns dein Mindset!
Du hast ein Faible für Zahlen. Daten schrecken dich nicht ab, sie wecken deine Neugier.
Du hast ein gutes Auge fürs Detail, arbeitest strukturiert und verlierst auch bei komplexen Aufgaben nicht den Überblick.
Du hast Lust auf eine steile Lernkurve, nimmst Feedback als Chance zum Wachstum und bringst dich proaktiv ins Team ein.
Du hast idealerweise schon eine Idee, in welche Richtung es für dich gehen könnte - oder Lust, das gemeinsam mit uns herauszufinden.
Erste Praktika oder Berührungspunkte im digitalen Marketing sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
Mentoring & Training: Du nimmst an zahlreichen internen und externen Schulungen teil. Erfahrene Kollegen stehen dir permanent als Mentoren zur Seite.

Fokus-Squads & Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten in agilen, 6–7-köpfigen Fokus-Squads direkt an unseren Kunden. Das bedeutet für dich: kurze Wege, ein intensives Teamgefühl und gemeinsamer Erfolg, den ihr als Einheit feiert.
Agenturleben, das Spaß macht: Eine harmonische Zusammenarbeit, flache Hierarchien und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig pushen. Dazu Teamevents, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks.
Flexibilität: Auch als Trainee genießt du bei uns flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice.
Internationale Luft: Durch unser Netzwerk von 28 Partnerbüros arbeitest du in einem wirklich globalen Umfeld.
Die Perspektive: Unser klares Ziel ist es, dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss deines Traineeships als festen Junior Manager in deiner Spezialdisziplin in unser Team zu übernehmen.
Bist du bereit für diese Herausforderung?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist kein Muss – zeig uns in deinem Lebenslauf oder in ein paar persönlichen Zeilen, warum du für das digitale Marketing brennst und warum Zahlen deine besten Freunde sind. Verrate uns dabei gern, welche Disziplin dich am meisten reizt (oder ob du dich bewusst noch nicht festlegen willst).
Bei uns zählt Vielfalt. Wir leben Inklusion, Respekt und Chancengleichheit.Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow",['git'],1

software-engineer-i-new-grad-london-222523,Samsara,Software Engineer I (New Grad),"London, England, United Kingdom",False,1793227527,"Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.About the role:

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate ready to launch your career at the forefront of industrial IoT? Join us and help shape the future of connected operations. You will immediately dive into challenging, real-world projects with the freedom and responsibility of a full-time engineer. We believe in providing a greenfield opportunity for growth and a high degree of ownership from day one. You will build and innovate, making a tangible impact on our global customers. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.

At Samsara, New Grads can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform. Depending on the team, a New Grad may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world. They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.

On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.&nbsp
Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.

Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.&nbsp
You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will help keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and - most importantly - ensure workers return home safely.

You believe customers are more than a number. Our engineers are deeply invested in our customers and the daily problems they face. They visit customers in person to understand not just how Samsara helps them today, but where our products need to go next. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with success and product teams, and use metrics to ensure your work translates into real outcomes.

You're curious and self-driven. You challenge yourself outside of class - hackathons, side projects, tearing apart how something works just because you want to understand it. You move fast, embrace new technology, and treat learning as constant.

You're drawn to hard problems and own them end to end. You dig into complexity, research it thoroughly, and find the simplest solution that works - then see it through, holding yourself to a high standard along the way.

You're AI-forward. You've woven AI into how you work, whether that's accelerating debugging, drafting code, or exploring unfamiliar problem spaces faster. You're quick to experiment and always looking for smarter ways to build.
You're a collaborator. You work well independently and across cross-functional teams, and you're motivated by winning together, not just individually.

Our calculations are the ground truth it reasons over. What tools it has, how they're built, how they fail, and the evals that prove they work.Everything from raw source data to the number the assistant quotes: the pipelines, services and data models, with the testing and observability to prove the number is right and the evals that catch the model quoting the wrong one.You'll Probably HaveBuilt production systems from scratch, writing the code yourself rather than configuring managed services. Your code comes with tests, and you leave things tidier than you found them.Depth in at least one of SQL, Spark, Databricks/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow/Temporal or dbt. Bonus if you've shaped any of them into something a model can query, through a metrics layer, metric views or an MCP server.Time with CI/CD, Docker, cloud infrastructure (we're on Azure) and observability. Even better if you set them up for a team.An interest in the business behind the data. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you'll say so, and you'll build the guard-rail so the model says so too.Treated your own workflow as something to engineer. AI has already taken over the repetitive parts of it, and you're the person others ask how to do the same.How We WorkWe're a small team with plenty to do. What you build is yours from start to finish.There’s no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. column3: We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.&lt

The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? column1: senior-infrastructure-manager-ashington-133099,Partnerize,Senior Infrastructure Manager,"Ashington, England, United Kingdom",False,1793202362,"Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.The Role&nbsp
We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Manager who is, first and foremost, a people leader.

In this role, your primary responsibility is the health, performance, and career growth of your engineering team. While you must possess a solid technical background to understand the challenges your team faces, your day-to-day focus will not be hands-on technical work. Instead, you will use your experience to remove blockers, guide decision-making, and ensure your engineers have the environment they need to succeed.

You will lead the Infrastructure Solutions team within the wider Technical Operations department. Your engineers are responsible for building the environment, delivering projects as requested by Engineering and Product, and ensuring we remain available, scalable, and secure. They are not responsible for the BAU function of the platforms that is managed by another team within Technical Operations. The Infrastructure Solutions team takes a concept or idea and makes that into a reality within the boundaries and constraints of our platforms.&nbsp
You will be managing a team of engineers who individually possess experience in:
On-Premise Linux systems, Container solutions, Debian packaging, Ansible, data streaming and queuing technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
Advanced database management knowledge (MySQL, Postgres) in replicated environments.
Physical Network management, with an on-prem estate that is Juniper focused.&nbsp
Platform engineer focused on building, maintaining and supporting an Internal Developer Platform (CI/CD)

It is important to be transparent about the environment you are joining. We operate at high velocity with a broad and complex technology estate. However, we are a lean team, not a giant corporation with endless resources.

You will rarely have the luxury of focusing on a single task for weeks at a time. You will be required to shift focus multiple times a week, and sometimes multiple times a day, as business priorities evolve.
Because we are a lean team, we wear many hats. You must be comfortable pivoting from a strategic discussion to an operational challenge without losing momentum.
Success in this role requires the ability to maintain high standards while navigating a workload that changes dynamically. This is not a role for those who prefer a slow, singular focus

column1: centrale-lyon-doctorat-modelisation-predictive-de-materiaux-polymeres-recycles-par-inference-statistique-et-apprentissage-machine-hybride-ecully-4439,CENTRALE LYON,CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.,"Ecully, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France",False,1793008313,"ContexteLe projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingénierie@Lyon, propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux. Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique. Cas d’étude Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.  Profil recherchéLe profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.Type de contratLe contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.

Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von SC Ventures im Enterprise-Segment
Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ab Senior Consultant / Berater-Level) bei einer Top-Strategieberatung (MBB, Big4-Consulting o. ä.) oder vergleichbarer Inhouse-Strategiefunktion
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen/Geschäftsführungen von Unternehmen relevanter Größenordnung
Fähigkeit, komplexe Transformationsprojekte eigenständig zu strukturieren und zu verantworten – ohne engmaschige Freigabeprozesse
Executive Presence: Du überzeugst auf Augenhöhe, ohne dich hinter einer großen Marke verstecken zu müssen
Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung und Beteiligung, nicht nur ein Gehalt
Branchenkenntnis Bildungssektor/AZAV von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – die Beratungslogik zählt mehr als die Sektor-Historie

Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen
Schnelle Entscheidungswege – keine drei Freigabeschleifen zwischen dir und dem Mandanten

Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und klare Perspektive Richtung Partner-Modell/Teamleitung

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.
Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.
Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.
Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.
This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.
